rounds.title: My Future Plans
rounds.support: What are you going to study next year? What job will you have in the future?
rounds.challenge: By 2035, what will you have achieved? What will you be doing on a normal Tuesday?
words: Next year, I am going to...

rounds.title: University vs Getting a Job
rounds.support: Defend your side. Why is your option good? What will you learn?
rounds.challenge: Defend your side. Answer your partner's arguments. How will this choice change your future?

rounds.title: A Modern Job
rounds.support: Describe the picture to your partner. What is his job? What is he going to do next?
rounds.challenge: What skills will he need? Will AI have replaced this job by 2040? Discuss together.

rounds.title: The Careers Advisor
rounds.support: Have a meeting. The advisor asks questions to help the confused student choose a future path.
rounds.challenge: Discuss long-term goals. Set specific career milestones using future continuous and future perfect tenses.

rounds.title: The Gap Year
rounds.support: You want to take a gap year before studying. Suggest different ideas. Agree on one plan.
rounds.challenge: How will you fund it? How will it benefit your future career? Negotiate a realistic plan.

rounds.title: Jobs in 2050
rounds.support: Invent a new job for the year 2050. Take turns adding details. What will people do?
rounds.challenge: Describe this futuristic career. What global problems will they be solving? How will technology have changed?
